title: ophiocaulon gummifer
intro: Ophiocaulon gummifer, commonly known as Khat, is a plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula, belonging to the Celastraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from fatigue and enhancing mental alertness. The health benefits of Ophiocaulon gummifer include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and potentially aiding in weight loss. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include cathinone and cathine, which have stimulant and anxiolytic properties.
